description: The battle concluded, Yuyuko regained her composure, everyone rested briefly at Hakugyokurō, Youmu cleaned the garden, and each person bid farewell and embarked on their journey home amidst the tranquility.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Me?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Eek! Because that's what the fairies all say!" #hides behind others

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Everyone can come... Let's talk about it after we rest tonight!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Re... Reimu-sama, do you really eat children..." #hiding to the side with Sunshi and Lina

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Let's go back. Mokou might be getting impatient."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Then wiped non-existent drool.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Then... then please eat the cherries, not me!" #offers the last cherries while performing dogeza

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hoho"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Eek! So scary!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Reimu excitedly puts away the cherries.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: Will Yukari Yakumo come tomorrow? Never mind, asking is pointless. A suspicious person like her probably won't show up.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Gensokyo, Yakumo Residence.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Good." #nods

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Great!"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Can you show me Gensokyo as it is now?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Ge Qing and Reimu's shadows darted across Gensokyo's high sky.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "...Gensokyo in spring."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Hmph."

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "Is that so... Well, that's fine. It seems sometimes you are more perceptive than I am."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: As she spoke, she flew over the Human Village with Ge Qing.

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: "No need. A few worshippers came here today. You can go check the Offering Box."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Really?!"

conversation.speaker: player3
conversation.text: #Wordless, turns and leaves.

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The early spring melting snow carried a warm breath.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Yuuka-sama is probably asleep..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: The snow in the flower field was almost melted.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Yuuka-sama, I'm back."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Kurumi should be asleep by now.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh? What's this?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Has Xueyu returned home? I have a little something to do. There seems to be a very cute little pet near the Sunflower Field recently. I went out to catch a pet and will probably be back in the evening. There's food in the kitchen, should still be warm. You've worked hard all day, rest well. Next to the note, there's a chibi Yuyuko drawn holding a butterfly net.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Hmm... looks like Sunchi is going to have a new friend." #pets Sunchi in her arms

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Creak"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "When the time comes, I'll just say... I went to play in the Human Village today."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: This is the sound of the door opening. "Oh my?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh?" #turns to look at the door

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Playing in the Human Village today?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Mhm mhm mhm mhm" #nods hurriedly. "To... today I went to play in the Human Village, ate some oden and stuff..."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Behind, an elegant woman wearing a red vest and a yellow tie is standing there. "Eh... that's nice." "As long as you're happy." As she says this, she pulls out a huge butterfly net from behind her. It's very dark outside. Can't see what's in the butterfly net. Only a dark shadow struggling can be seen.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Uh... Lady Yuyuko, what's that?" #tilts head to look at the butterfly net

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "A pet." "Very cute, right?" She steps into the light. Inside the butterfly net. A familiar figure comes into view. "Today she ran off somewhere." "Made me wait a long time to catch her."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Eh eh eh?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Seems like a newly born fairy near the Sunflower Field. How about it, very cute, right?" She lifts the butterfly net. Lina is caught inside.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Wahhhh I'm going to be eaten!"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Li... Lina?!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Eh?" "What, you know her?" She takes Lina out of the net, holding her.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Uh... I, I met her today when I went to the Human Village."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "As cute as Lily White. Can we keep her at home?" "Eh... so she ran there." Yuyuko nods.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I'm not a domestic fairy, I'm wild."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Th... this depends on Miss Lina's wishes, right?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Wild and domestic aren't much different." "You'll be very happy here." "Look, you have a companion." She points at Xueyu.

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Grr... there's someone who suddenly nets me when I'm about to rest, feels dangerous."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Think about it, it'll be fun." Yuyuko places the Lina she's holding on the ground.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Lady Yuyuko isn't a bad person..."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Hmm... can I eat delicious food from the Human Village?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Giving her the right to choose. "Naturally." "Eating whatever you want is quite simple."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Then... then I'll stay here for a while and see."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Yuyuko nods. "Eh, good."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Then... pleased to meet you, Miss Lina."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Yuyuko smiles slightly, hugging Xueyu and Lina in her arms. "Good, now we're all family."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Huh?" #stunned for a moment

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "What are family?"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Your relationship with the cherry tree?"

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "It's... people who can stay together, encourage each other, and keep each other company."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Eh... you're quite eloquent."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "The tree existed before me."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Lina, do you like the tree?"

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "Yes, I can only grow when the tree grows."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Then, family is probably that kind of relationship."

conversation.speaker: player2
conversation.text: "I see."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: "Mm."

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Yeah, both Sunkui and I are feeling a bit hungry."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Yuka straightens up and stretches.

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Yay!"

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Watching the two excited figures run off into the distance,
